modes.chronon: crates/lattice chronon::Chronon, CPU, one core: the reference every other mode must equal
modes.event: crates/lattice-event EventCore: cells, per-item events, calendar (build step 1)
modes.metal: crates/lattice-metal MetalChronon: chronon mode on the M1 GPU (build step 5)
modes.regions: crates/allocator over EventCore regions on 8 workers (build steps 2-4)
modes.hybrid: per-region choice between event and metal by measured cost (not built when frozen)

units.why: Julien cares about p95/p99 and the single worst frame. Every advance runs in units of unit_ops charged operations and every unit is timed. A frame is at most one unit per worker, so the worst unit bounds the worst frame.
units.verdict: SMOOTH if the worst unit of the whole run is at most target_max_unit_ms, else JANK (step-2 exit criterion; reported per rung, does not stop the climb)

track_gates.why: Build-step exit criteria (docs/HANDOFF.md 'Current plan'), frozen before any mode ran.

cost_per_event_flat.measure: ops / fired events at the largest passing rung over the smallest rung

useful_work.on: every passing rung with at least 1000 fired events

smooth.on: every passing rung: worst unit at most target_max_unit_ms

gas_one_million.rule: passes within the rung wall cap in at least one mode

carry_bound.why: the relativistic carry must stay bounded (a random walk over a million collisions would reach about 1000 quanta)
carry_bound.rule: every carry component (energy, px, py) at most 64·F·m_max·γ_max³, with F = 2^16 and γ_max = Γ_max/F over genesis and final velocities
